chapters.title: Scenario 3: AI agents with Azure Functions

takeaways: Choose Azure Logic Apps when you need VNet integration, private endpoints, managed identities and policy-enforced governance; keep Power Automate for departmental convenience.
Power Automate's tenant-wide action limits throttle high-volume workloads, while Logic Apps Standard and high-throughput consumption let you tune concurrency and scale.
Orchestrate declaratively in Logic Apps and move complex code into Azure Functions, tracing every hop with correlation IDs in Application Insights.
hook: Power Automate and Azure Logic Apps share the same connectors, but they behave very differently once enterprise volume, hybrid networks and auditors arrive. This episode benchmarks both across secured on-prem data, high-volume API orchestration and AI agents with Azure Functions. Architects and integration teams get a clear rule for which platform to pick and why.
